series_level_findings: EUROPE: The CHipCie (TU Delft) archive at https://chipcie.wisv.ch/archive is the key multi-year source and was under-used before: it holds scanned/text problem sets for ERC 1988 (Eindhoven, 12 Nov 1988), ERC 1989 (Eindhoven; listed 10 Nov but the final was 2 Dec 1989 per Cursor), ERC 1990 (Eindhoven, 3 Nov 1990, PLUS a full 33-team final-standings scan), ERC 1991 (Gent), WERC 1992 (Gent, 15 Nov 1992, text PDF header 'ACM Scholastic Programming Contest, November 15, 1992 — Western European Regional'), WERC 1993 (Swansea, 14 Nov 1993) and WERC 1994 (VU Amsterdam, 11 Nov 1994) — nothing before 1988. Period naming: 'European Regional Finals of the 1988-89 ACM Scholastic Programming Contest' (1988), 'European Regional Finals' (1989), 'European Regional Contest' (1990 standings), 'European Regional Final' (1991), 'Western European Regional' (1992-93); Dutch press called it 'Europese finale' / 'EK programmeren'. Eindhoven (Tom Verhoeff RCD, study association GEWIS, Faculty of Math & CS) hosted 1988-1990 consecutively; the TU/e weekly Cursor has a complete PDF archive at https://www.cursor.tue.nl/fileadmin/user_upload/magazine/jaargangen/<vol>/nl/<issue>.pdf (vol 31 = 1988-89, weekly numbering; OCR'd text is readable) and reported each edition (18.11.88 results; 24.11.89 preview; 08.12.89 results; 02.11.90 preview). 1988: 25 teams/8 countries, won by École des Mines Paris, Leiden 2nd; 1989: 9 countries, won by TU/e, Leiden 2nd; 1990: 33 teams/14 countries, won by VU Amsterdam. Hosts/years for 1983-1987 remain unidentified; the only pre-1988 pointers are the CHipCie lineage note on file and the BCS remark that 1993 Swansea was the 'last' British Isles hosting (suggesting an earlier UK host). Best remaining multi-year sources are behind paywalls/blocks: SIGCSE '90 panel 'The ACM Scholastic Programming Contest 1977 to 1990' (doi 10.1145/319059.323416), CSC'93 papers 10.1145/170791.171152 and 10.1145/170791.171161, and the Wayback copy of icpc.baylor.edu/past/ (snapshot 20190119052159 exists but web.archive.org is SITE_BLOCKED for this fetcher). EAST CENTRAL: no period source for 1984-1988 surfaced; the Alma College repository proves a 56-team East Central regional in the 1990/91 (or 1991/92) season won by Alma College, which then placed 4th at the finals — a useful anchor for ecna-1990 pending season confirmation. The official ECNA archive (icpc-ecna.ysu.edu/PastResults/) starts in 2000. Usenet routes are all dead from here: the Utzoo archive has been removed from archive.org, usenetarchives.com is a Cloudflare JS challenge, the AltaVista Utzoo mirror (altavista.superglobalmegacorp.com) returns no results even for common words, Google Groups is JS-only. Student-newspaper archives (Michigan Daily, Lantern, Observer, mathNEWS) are not Google-indexed for the 1980s and their search endpoints are blocked/robots — a browser session is needed.
